message.content: {"issues":[{"number":18,"field":"context","problem":"The location map is described as having a point near the west coast in the central part of Korea. In the source, the non-Jeju point is inland in the central-eastern part of the peninsula; it is not on or near the west coast."},{"number":19,"field":"context","problem":"The map is described as a map of South Korea with nationwide city/county boundaries. The source map is a regional map of Gangwon Province, with its internal administrative boundaries and three shaded areas. Consequently, the descriptions of A, B, and C as nationwide middle/southeastern/southwestern locations (including C as coastal) are misleading; C is not shown as a southwesterly coastal region in the source."}],"checked_numbers":[16,17,18,19,20]}
